subject: Demo request - follow-up from Webinar: Scaling LLM inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: webinars@events.co
Date: 2026-10-18T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: Thanks for joining the webinar - demo next steps

Hi Samira,

Thanks for registering for our webinar on Scaling LLM inference - glad you could make it! I saw you signed up for a follow-up demo in the registration flow and wanted to reach out to schedule a short, 30-minute walkthrough tailored to GreenWave Health.

Would any of these slots work for you next week (PT):
- Tue 10/20, 10:00-10:30am PT
- Tue 10/20, 2:00-2:30pm PT
- Wed 10/21, 11:00-11:30am PT

If none of those fit, feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/demo-30.

Quick agenda: 1) a brief look at latency/cost tradeoffs for inference, 2) how our Dedicated and Private deployment options map to regulated healthcare workloads, 3) next steps and pricing.

I've attached a short demo deck with examples of prior healthcare customers. Looking forward to connecting - can you confirm who else from your team will join? If you have any data residency or security questions up front, happy to loop in our security lead.

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
redwoodinference.com

Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf
